audit_comment: APPENDIX 3: THE CLERICAL QUICK-REFERENCE CHARTS, BATCH EIGHT - the D&DG walk round twenty-eight, print p. 143: the eighth and LAST batch of deity rows - the twenty-one Norse rows (the nineteen data rows plus the Surtur and Thrym cross-references) and the seven Sumerian rows - riding the roster data file. NO GAP FLIP - the App 3 box stays open: the flip was held one more round per Curtiss (the R869 no-flip precedent extends past the last chart batch; gap_flips reads empty, the census holds 20/4). The print voice is the ROTATED tesseract pass, collated against the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows. The headline adjudications: the Frigga female-only flag (the geometry seats the single X at the F column, the L&L voice agrees) and the Hel male-only flag (the same class); the Thor form burnt animals pinned by print over the L&L crafted items (eyeball flag, the R869 Druaga precedent); the Frey ornate helm restored over the L&L orntate garble; the Loki strife; fire semicolon pinned by print; the Uty and idun name garbles restored per the R865/R866 pins; the Surtur and Thrym cross-reference rows pinned as grid rows with 0-sentinel fields (their chart data landed in R875).

banner.title: Appendix 3: the clerical quick-reference chart, batch eight - the D&DG walk round twenty-eight, print p. 143: the 21 Norse and 7 Sumerian rows across the 13 printed columns.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the ROTATED extract/ddg tesseract pass (pNNN_rot_full.txt + pNNN_rot_tsv.tsv, pdf page 143; the second printing); the collation voice: the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows. The adjudications: the Frigga female-only and Hel male-only single-X flags (the TSV geometry seats them, both voices agree); the Thor form burnt animals pinned by print over the L&L crafted items (eyeball flag); the Frey ornate helm restored over the L&L orntate garble; the Loki strife; fire semicolon pinned by print; the Uty and idun garbles restored per the R865/R866 crossref pins; the Nin-Hursag chart capitalization pinned per the chart print; the Surtur and Thrym cross-reference rows pinned as grid rows with 0-sentinel fields (their chart data landed in R875). NO GAP FLIP: the App 3 box stays open - the flip held one more round per Curtiss. The batch order runs the alphabetical Norse walk then the alphabetical Sumerian walk.
